To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the main challenges in monitoring edge computing applications are the lack of a monitoring system that can adapt to the dynamic changes of edge computing environments, and the lack of monitoring tools that support the monitoring of applications within edge computing scenarios.

the monitoring requirements are not yet fully addressed by any existing monitoring tool; there are still some monitoring requirements to be addressed; and some requirements have been addressed by some of the existing monitoring tools.
the monitoring of edge computing applications is not yet fully established, and that a new taxonomy is necessary to address the monitoring requirements of such applications.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the identification of the main challenges and requirements in monitoring edge computing applications and their orchestration.
the development of an integrated monitoring solution for adaptive applications within edge frameworks.
the identification of new requirements for monitoring self-adaptive applications in the context of edge computing, and the analysis of the existing monitoring tools in this context.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
there is a need for a monitoring system for edge applications.
the monitoring solutions for edge computing applications are still immature, and that further research in this area is needed.
the monitoring of self adaptive applications within the edge computing paradigm is still in its infancy and requires further investigation.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the monitoring requirements are not fully addressed yet, and that there is a need to provide a monitoring framework to support the monitoring requirements within the edge computing frameworks.
the existing monitoring solutions are not yet sufficient to meet the needs of monitoring self-adaptive applications orchestrated on edge computing frameworks.
there is still a need for a comprehensive monitoring solution that can meet all of the requirements for monitoring adaptive applications within edge.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the monitoring requirements for edge computing applications are not yet fully covered by existing monitoring technologies.

a comprehensive monitoring system should be able to meet a large set of requirements, including those related to the monitoring of applications, edge computing frameworks, and edge computing environments.

the monitoring of adaptive applications orchestrated within edge computing frameworks is still in its infancy and that a comprehensive monitoring framework for edge computing applications is still to be developed.
